summary: Backend-only testing of Admin Impersonation feature (iter413ca). All 7 pytest contract tests pass + additional contract validation (missing identifiers→400, non-existent maker→404, expires_in_seconds=7200, no admin claims, sv claim present, imp_by=admin email).
critical_code_review_comments: JWT correctly carries `sv` (session_version) claim — needed so /api/maker/me's _check_session_version accepts the token. Verified live.
imp_by is lowercased admin email — confirms the comparator in admin-on-admin check is case-safe.

Test file does NOT have a pytest 'smoke' marker, so the requested invocation `pytest -m smoke -k 'iter413ca'` would collect 0 items. Used file-level invocation instead. Recommend tagging tests with @pytest.mark.smoke if the smoke marker convention is desired.
test_credentials: Admin minted via maker_auth.issue_admin_magic_token using ADMIN_EMAILS/OPS_EMAIL (resolved to williams342@gmail.com in this env).
seed_data_creation: Fixtures self-seed/cleanup makers + community_users + admin_audit rows. No persistent test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend impersonation contract is solid. Frontend (ImpersonationBanner + UsersTab/ApprovedMakersTab impersonate buttons + lib/impersonate.js localStorage flow) is still untested — main agent flagged frontend would be a follow-up. When testing FE, verify: (1) new tab opens with target session, (2) banner sticky on every impersonated page, (3) exit clears localStorage + closes session, (4) original admin tab unaffected, (5) banned-user impersonate button is disabled.
